purpose: Development-only known-settings reference for the independent engine.

execution.address_layout: Original PE sections occupy their original addresses inside a private x86 helper. Helper code and imports reside above the reserved range.
execution.initialization: Resolve original imports, construct six parameter registries, and invoke the original core constructor. Application startup and activation code are not invoked.
execution.integrity: Pin the executable and installation DLL hashes. Record the helper hash and typed parameter-registry hash. Build the helper with a fixed PE timestamp.
execution.distribution: The helper, installed reference libraries, recordings, and reference exports remain outside the npm package. The runtime implementation and Node tests do not load them.

inputs.dimensions: 8 by 8 for split images; 17 by 13 otherwise.
inputs.pixels: Explicit BGRA byte arrays, including premultiplied alpha transitions. File decoding is outside these captures.
inputs.parameters: Record all 100 typed numeric core parameters for every image. Color count is explicit, so automatic classification and automatic color-count selection are outside this corpus.
inputs.ordering: One fresh core processes the 15 images in recorded order. State is retained between images.

stages.detail: Populate the original bitmap and ImageMagick input cache. Clear the filter-applied flag as the original image-transfer routine does.
Apply the original input processing. Record the resulting working BGRA bytes; the photograph alpha case exercises noise filtering.
Include measurement, weighted/unweighted refinement, candidate scoring, quantization, and retained-candidate copying.
Use the original full-resolution input preparation before segmentation.
Use the same (0, 1, 0) arguments as the recovered GUI stage wrapper. Record the region map.
Run all three original phases with argument 1.
Use the original extension dispatcher and original writers for all six formats.

geometry.regions: Preserve BGRA bytes, pixel counts, color identifiers, parents, contour node indices, and seven-integer fitted edge records.
geometry.nodes: Preserve double-precision coordinates, cubic indices, and node kinds.
geometry.edges: Native kind 0 draws a line between successive contour nodes. Kind 1 uses a cubic in stored order; kind 2 reverses its four points. Confirmed by 0x4741b0.
geometry.cubics: Record indices and all eight double coordinates for referenced cubics. Original allocation can include uninitialized slots; follow live region edges rather than treating reserved slots as geometry.
geometry.pointers: Never serialize process pointers or raw object structs as geometry.
geometry.before_smoothing: Capture initialized coordinates, kinds/flags, ordered contours, boundary flags/adjacent regions/incoming sample counts, neighbors and parents immediately after original contour extraction. Exclude three uninitialized padding bytes in each boundary record. Save minimal 15-case pipeline-contour-reference.json for independent segmentation-plus-contour checks.
geometry.after_smoothing: Capture initialized contour geometry immediately after original 0x497c30 and before Bezier fitting. Save all 15 states plus preceding raw contours and shared PRNG states in pipeline-smoothing-reference.json. The native corpus moves 409 nodes and changes 192 kinds/flags. Independent complete smoothing remains unimplemented.

random_state.observation: The anti-alias smoothing cases consume the shared core PRNG. The original perturbation routine at 0x495a30 uses two uniform calls per perturbed point. A full independent engine must share this state with palette generation.

export.shape_mode: Explicit native mode 0, stacked shapes. Other export options retain original constructor values.
export.dimensions: Explicit pixel viewBox and point output dimensions equal the input dimensions; original output DPI is 72.
export.checks: Require successful native writer status and capture file hashes. Parse SVG XML. Check format signatures/trailers for other formats and EMF header size. These checks are not complete semantic validators for all formats.
export.repeatability: Two fresh ordered runs produce identical numeric geometry. SVG, PDF, AI, DXF, and EMF exports are byte-identical on this host. EPS files differ only in their observable creation-date line.
export.clock: EPS creation dates remain part of the output contract. Classifying that difference does not establish byte parity for the EPS files.

limits: This is an original-engine reference corpus. It does not establish independent conversion parity, GUI behavior, file decoding, automatic modes, all export options, large-image resizing, manual edits, undo, batch failures, or cancellation.
